jobs.description: Intelance is a UK advisory and assurance firm working across enterprise architecture, cyber assurance, AI governance and data governance. We run information security management systems (ISMS) for growing technology companies certified to ISO/IEC 27001:2022. We are appointing a hands on Google Workspace Security Engineer as an associate contractor to close technical security gaps for our clients. Your first assignment is with an ISO 27001 certified technology company with offices in the UK and Asia. You will set up email data loss prevention (DLP), which stops sensitive data leaving the company by email, and device management, which keeps company laptops and phones secure. The work runs from December 2026 to January 2027 and needs about 6 to 10 days in total. This is an associate panel role. Each assignment is agreed separately with a written scope, timetable and day rate. Tasks Review the client's current Google Workspace security settings and agree a short, practical plan. Design and set up Gmail DLP rules for the data that matters most, tested to avoid blocking normal work. Set up and tune device management for laptops and phones, using Google endpoint management or the client's chosen tool (for example Jamf, Kandji or Intune). Apply sensible device rules such as screen lock, disk encryption, updates and remote wipe. Check that each control works and collect clear evidence for the ISO 27001 surveillance audit. Link controls to the client's compliance platform (for example Vanta) where possible. Write short handover notes so the client's team can run the controls after you leave. Follow Intelance quality, security, confidentiality and change control procedures. Requirements Essential At least three years of hands on Google Workspace security administration in live company tenants. Has set up Gmail DLP rules in production. Has rolled out device management across macOS and mobile devices in production. Understands how these controls support ISO/IEC 27001:2022 or SOC
